description_en: Retrieves chat content from a specific checkpoint by specifying the session ID and AgentId
description_zh: 通过指定会话ID和AgentId，从特定检查点开始获取聊天内容
kebab_example: aliyun dms get-chat-content --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --session-id sess_12345 --agent-id xxxx-xxxx-xxxx --checkpoint 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetChatContent

parameters.help_en: The current DMS unit. Chinese mainland users of Alibaba Cloud should use cn-hangzhou by default
parameters.help_zh: 当前所在的DMS单元，阿里云国内站用户默认填入cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: dms_unit

parameters.help_en: The session ID. This parameter is required
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. This parameter is required
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The backend will return output starting from this checkpoint
parameters.help_zh: 后端将从这个接口开始返回输出
parameters.name: checkpoint

schema.description_en: Each data entry in the SSE response stream conforms to this JSON structure
schema.description_zh: SSE响应流的每条data都符合该json结构

category.description_en: The category of the message, used to assist in parsing the content of the json type. For example, `PLAN` indicates that the message is a display of an execution plan and conforms to the execution plan schema
category.description_zh: 消息的类别，用于辅助json类型的content的解析。如`PLAN`表示该消息是执行计划的展示，会符合执行计划的Schema

content_type.description_en: The type of the content field. Valid values: `[str, json]`. When the value is json, the content field can be further parsed as a JSON structure
content_type.description_zh: content字段的类型，可取值: `[str, json]`。当取值为json时，content字段可进一步解析为json结构

event_type.description_en: The type of the message, used to distinguish control signals from actual messages. For example, `CHAT_START` indicates the beginning of an Agent reply, `CHAT_FINISH` indicates the end of an Agent reply, `DATA` indicates a message carrying content, and `DELTA` indicates a part of an incrementally output message
event_type.description_zh: 消息的类型，用于区分控制符和具体消息。如 `CHAT_START`表示Agent的一次回复开始，`CHAT_FINISH`表示Agent的一次回复结束。`DATA`表示这是一条携带了内容的消息，`DELTA`表示这是一条增量输出的消息的一部分

level.description_en: The output level of the message. A higher level indicates higher importance
level.description_zh: 消息的输出级别，级别越高越重要

timestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp in seconds when this message was generated by the Agent
timestamp.description_zh: 这条消息在Agent产生的UNIX时间戳，单位为秒
